text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On one clear, sunny day...
Dream Journey asked me
to take a commemorative photo for her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I want to send a photo to my family.
choice_data_list: For your family?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I truly wanted to show you
how I look in my racing attire.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Could I get a few copies, please?
choice_data_list: Of course, sure thing!
Of course, sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I puffed out my chest proudly, but... I wondered why
she'd trust an amateur like me with the shoot.
With her, you'd think she'd hire a professional...
choice_data_list: (...I'll give it my best shot, even as a beginner!)
(...I'll do my best, even as a beginner!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for agreeing to this.
Now then, I shall go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to a photo that captures your essence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since this photo is for your family,
I thought they'd be happier if they could see
what life is like here at the academy...
choice_data_list: First, let's take a photo in the Expedition Support Committee room!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...Shall I strike a pose or something?
choice_data_list: For now, let's just keep things like usual.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: As usual...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: (…I-I'm getting kinda nervous…)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A classroom this time... is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's a strange sensation somehow,
standing here in my racewear.
choice_data_list: (I guess I do stand out a little)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey's racing outfit is quite formal.
It creates quite a contrast with her student persona, but...
choice_data_list: (She really is so cool, isn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The track... In that case,
shall I show you how I run?"
choice_data_list: ...is what I thought, but it looks tough.
...is what I thought, but it looks tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It seems capturing their running form
requires quite a bit of skill.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want to trouble you that much.
Shall we just strike a modest pose?
choice_data_list: Yeah, please.
Yeah, please do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey struck a pose.
I find myself once again captivated by her overwhelming presence in her racing racewear, seemingly swallowing even the sunlight...
choice_data_list: The design looks really cool, doesn't it?
The design looks really cool, right?
Is there a theme to the outfit?
Is there a theme to the outfit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey struck a pose.
I find myself once again captivated by her overwhelming presence in her racing racewear, seemingly swallowing even the sunlight...
choice_data_list: The design looks really cool, doesn't it?
The design looks really cool, right?
Is there a theme to the outfit?
Is there a theme to the outfit?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you very much.
choice_data_list: Is there anything you were particularly particular about?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Perhaps the part inspired by family?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The coloring was inspired by my goldsmith father...
and I've also incorporated the artistic sensibilities
of my illustrator mother.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There's even detailing
on the inside lining of the coat.
Can you see it?
choice_data_list: I can see it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's quite a bold slit in her skirt.
It creates a bit of a contrast with her calm demeanor.
choice_data_list: ...Overall, she looks pretty mature.
...Overall, she looks pretty mature.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit embarrassing to admit, but...
I suppose I was just trying to act cool.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I am rather petite...
Please consider this my best attempt at resisting
that, to make myself appear more adult-like.
choice_data_list: I see...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Wanting to appear mature’...
It hardly seems like an emotion
Dream Journey would harbor, but..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Are you not convinced?
For me, this is something necessary.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am representing my family, after all.
I must have a commanding presence, no?
choice_data_list: (I see...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Learning of the love for her family woven into her racing outfit, I renew my determination. I want to take a photo that conveys those feelings.
choice_data_list: Let's take a few more shots!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. You might call it...
pride and prestige, indeed.
choice_data_list: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Every member of my family is irreplaceable
and truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Since I'll be running in the Twinkle Series as their representative... I have to take pride in it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for prestige, we achieve it across every detail
of the outfit by commissioning skilled artisans for the craft.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for the tailoring, we partnered with a historic tailor
to create a sense of profound dignity.
choice_data_list: They really paid attention to the texture, huh.
They really paid attention to the texture, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Standing next to Orfe's racing silks,
I cannot afford to look inferior.
choice_data_list: You're even thinking about Orfevre, huh

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. How could I not take her into account?
She is... light itself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So that when we stand side by side, I can bring out that light...
I chose pure black.
choice_data_list: Support you... huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Rest assured.
—I have no intention of remaining in her shadow.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The brighter the light...
the more vivid the color black becomes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I love Or...
unless I can stand alongside her, I cannot truly call myself family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Learning of the love for her family woven into her racing outfit, I renew my determination. I want to take a photo that conveys those feelings.
choice_data_list: Let's take a few more shots!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I poured my heart into taking the photos... and Dream Journey seemed satisfied with them.
...At least, I think so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the photoshoot the other day.
Thanks to you...
my family was very happy with it.
choice_data_list: That's great!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. The ones taken by the professional were nice, but... retaking them was the right call.
choice_data_list: ...Hm? A professional!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hastily asked to see the folder...
Inside were stunning photos taken in a proper studio,
truly worthy of being called works of art.
choice_data_list: I-It's a wonderful photo...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a magnificent finish.
Truly the work of a professional... however—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've changed my mind. There will surely be plenty of
chances to see flawless photographs in the future.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "In that case, showing you a more relaxed side of myself in everyday life... might feel more special, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Just as planned.
My family was... very pleased with it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I asked you.
—Thank you once again."
